Monday, October 3, 2022  7:00 PM  Council Chamber / Teleconference

In accordance with Assembly Bill 361 (AB 361), City Council Resolution Nos. 2487, 2490, 2491, 2493, 2498,
2499, 2503, 2505, 2507, 2512, 2519, 2521 and 2530 due to the continuing state of emergency, including masking
and social distancing directives as a result of the threat of the COVID-19 virus, this meeting is being broadcast
via teleconference. Members of the public may participate in-person in the Council Chambers, or virtually in the
meeting in the following ways:

- Members of the public may listen to the meeting live by calling: (1 669 900 9128) from any phone, Meeting ID:
844 4819 5823 Passcode: 781993. (Please note you will not have the ability to speak using the call in option from
a phone line.)

- Public correspondence may be emailed to the carolc@rollinghillsestatesca.gov. Emails received before 5:00
p.m. prior to the start of the meeting will be forwarded to the Planning Commission for their consideration and
included as part of the record.

- Members of the public may also comment online using eComment on the “Meeting Agendas, Minutes &
Videos” page of the City’s website (www.rhe.city/agendas). Once the agenda is published, there will be an
“eComment” button next to the linked agenda under "Upcoming Events". Follow this link to the City’s SpeakUp
page. After you register, you may comment on any item on that particular agenda. These comments can be seen
by the public, will be considered by the Council and become part of the
record.

- Members of the public who wish to speak during this meeting may join the Zoom meeting by accessing the
Zoom app from a computer (downloaded at Zoom.com) or tablet or phone (downloaded in the App Store), by
entering the following credentials: Meeting ID: 844 4819 5823 Passcode: 781993.

- Members of the public who join the Zoom meeting will not have video, and may request to speak using the
following process: After joining the Zoom meeting, if you wish to speak, please select the "raise hand" option at
the lower portion of your screen. The host will send you a chat message to identify which item on the agenda you
would like to speak on and will unmute your mic at the appropriate time.

Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each Open Session agenda item are available on
the City's website under Meeting Agendas, Minutes & Videos at www.rhe.city.

MINUTES
  PLANNING MISSION MEETING
  MONDAY, OCTOBER 3, 2022

A regular meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to
order by CHAIR SCHACHTER at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chamber, 4045 Palos Verdes
Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates, CA 90274, and via teleconference pursuant to Assembly Bill 361.

2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

CHAIR SCHACHTER led those assembled in the Pledge of Allegiance.

3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present:  Schachter, Yoo, Carman, Low, Olson, Edler

  Commissioners Absent:  Medawar

  City Staff Present:  David Wahba, Director of Community Development & Public Works
  Carol Corea, Administrative Analyst

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

A.  APPROVAL OF PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES, SEPTEMBER 6, 2022

COMMISSIONER EDLER made a motion, seconded by VICE CHAIR YOO to,

  APPROVE THE PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES OF SEPTEMBER 6,
  2022.

There being no objection, CHAIR SCHACHTER so ordered

5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

NONE

6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

A.  READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS PRESENTED FOR
  CONSIDERATION TO THE PLANNING COMMISSION WILL BE WAIVED AND ALL
  SUCH ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS WILL BE READ BY TITLE ONLY.

COMMISSIONER CARMAN made a motion, seconded by VICE CHAIR YOO to,

  APPROVE ITEM NO. 6A

There being no objection, CHAIR SCHACHTER so ordered.

7.  OLD BUSINESS

A.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-220241; LOCATION: 19 DAPPLEGRAY LANE;
  APPLICANT: DAVID AND HELEN SHAW; A request for a Neighborhood Compatibility
  Determination (NC-220242) to legalize two unpermitted detached accessory structures
  built less than 7’ away from a bridle trail. A Variance (V-220243) is required to consider an
  application for building a structure less than 7’ to a bridle trail per RHEMC Section
  17.06.330. The proposal also includes a grading application (G-220244) for on-site
  grading greater than 3’ in depth and 20 cubic yards of import/export.

David Wahba, Director of Community Development and Public Works provided a verbal report on
Planning Application No. 220241 summarizing the staff report.

Director Wahba stated that staff recommends that the Planning Commission approve Resolution
No. PA-220241 denying both Variance Application No. V-220243 and Neighborhood Compatibility
Application No. NC-220242, requiring the applicant to demolish or relocate the unpermitted
accessory structures to comply with code, and separately approving Grading Application No. G-
220244.

COMMISSIONER EDLER made a motion, seconded by VICE CHAIR YOO to,

 PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
 MINUTES, OCTOBER 3, 2022
  1
   APPROVE PA-220196, A NEIGHBORHOOD COMPATIBILITY DETERMINATION (NC-
  220197) FOR A SPLIT-LEVEL HOME FEATURING AN ATTACHED TWO-CAR
  GARAGE, A SECOND-STORY DECK, COVERED PATIO, AND GRADING
  APPLICATION (G-220198), SUBJECT TO THE CONDITIONS OF APPROVAL IN THE
  STAFF REPORT.

AYES: Schachter, Yoo, Carman, Low, Olson, Edler
NOES:
ABSENT: Medawar
ABSTAIN:

Director Wahba stated that the Planning Commission approved Planning Application No. 220196.
There is a 20-day appeal period by where any member of the public may appeal this project to
the City Council.

8.  BUSINESS ITEM

A.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-220220; ADDRESS: 6 DEERHILL DRIVE, ROLLING
  HILLS ESTATES, CA 90274; APPLICANT: DOMINGO OTTOLIA; A request for a
  Neighborhood Compatibility Determination (NC-220221) for an interior remodel of an
  existing single-family residence that also includes a 269 sq. ft. single-story addition, façade
  update including new windows, doors, and siding, and redesigning the roof by removing
  the hip-style roof and replacing it with a standing seam metal roof. The proposal also
  includes increasing the roof ridge height from 12’-8" to 15’-10". This project was originally
  reviewed by the Planning Commission on July 11, 2022, whereby they recommended a
  redesign of the project.

David Wahba, Director of Community Development and Public Works provided a presentation on
Planning Application No. 220220 summarizing the staff report.

Director Wahba state that staff recommends that the Planning Commission approve PA-220220
(NC-220221) with the conditions outlined in the staff report.

Blake Taricco, Property Owner, thanked the Planning Commission for considering this project
and stated that he worked with staff and stated that he is happy with the result of the plan.

Domingo Ottolia, Architect, thanked the Planning Commission for its consideration of this project
and stated that it was a pleasure working with staff on this project.

COMMISSIONER EDLER made a motion, seconded VICE CHAIR YOO to,

  PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVE PA-220220  (NC-220221)  WITH  THE
  CONDITIONS OUTLINED IN THE STAFF REPORT.

AYES: Schachter, Yoo, Carman, Low, Olson, Edler
NOES:
ABSENT: Medawar
ABSTAIN:

Director Wahba stated that the Planning Commission approved Planning Application No. 220220.
There is a 20-day appeal period by where any member of the public may appeal this project to
the City Council.
